clips.title: The story
paras: Bluegill Marsh is a sodden mire in the western Wetlands that serves as the sprawling settlement for the hostile Bluegill murloc tribe. The waterways and huts are fiercely guarded by these aquatic humanoids under the rule of the brute known as Gobbler. Travelers heading through the western fens must navigate carefully to avoid being surrounded in the shallows.

Situated amidst the boggy flats of the western Wetlands, Bluegill Marsh is thick with mud, reeds, and the squawking war cries of its resident murlocs. The Bluegill tribe has erected crude primitive camps throughout the stagnant water, claiming this territory as their own. Unlike more isolated beasts of the swamp, these murlocs live and hunt in tightly knit packs. Wary wanderers and scouts from Menethil Harbor know that wading into their territory invites swift ambushes from every direction, especially with the formidable chieftain Gobbler prowling the murky shallows.
